knowledge_base.description: Login screen is used to enter username and password to access system.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Enter your assigned username and password to log in. Different roles (Admin, Operator) have different access levels.
knowledge_base.solution: Contact Admin if you forgot your credentials.

knowledge_base.description: Trend screen shows graphical data of machine values.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Navigate to Trend page from the sidebar to view live or historical data logs.
knowledge_base.solution: Use the filters to select specific date ranges or recipes.

knowledge_base.description: Alarm screen shows machine alarms. You can view active and historical alarms.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Open it from the sidebar menu to see alarm details and acknowledge them.
knowledge_base.solution: Resolve the physical issue on the machine and press Acknowledge.

knowledge_base.description: The Report screen allows you to view and export production data as PDF.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Open Reports from the sidebar, select filters, and click Export or View.
knowledge_base.solution: Ensure a USB/printer is connected if exporting/printing.

knowledge_base.description: To print report, open Report screen and click Print button.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Go to Reports, filter data, and select Print option.
knowledge_base.solution: Check printer connection and paper status.

knowledge_base.description: The main dashboard shows live gauges, counters, and status.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Use the Process Screen button to see real-time machine telemetry.
knowledge_base.solution: Watch the gauges and counters for operational feedback.

knowledge_base.description: Store and load machine parameters for different products.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Open Recipe page, select or create a recipe, and press Upload to PLC.
knowledge_base.solution: Ensure the machine is in a safe state before uploading.

knowledge_base.description: Configure system-wide settings and user permissions.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Access Settings from the sidebar (requires Admin/Manager role).
knowledge_base.solution: Only authorized personnel should change these settings.

knowledge_base.description: Add new operators or managers to the system.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Go to User Reg from the sidebar and fill in the details.
knowledge_base.solution: Ensure a unique username and strong password.

knowledge_base.description: Monitor the status of PLC binary inputs and outputs.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Go to Inputs or Outputs screen to see real-time signal status.
knowledge_base.solution: Green indicators mean the signal is ON, gray means OFF.

knowledge_base.description: Allows resetting of active alarms or counters.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Use the Reset button on the dashboard or alarm page.
knowledge_base.solution: Ensure the fault condition is cleared before resetting.

knowledge_base.description: Contains detailed logs of every production cycle with timestamps.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Navigate to Data Log from the sidebar to view historical part data.
knowledge_base.solution: Use the export button to save logs as a spreadsheet.

knowledge_base.description: Shows the active sequence of machine valves during a cycle.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Open Valve Sequence to monitor valve timings and states.
knowledge_base.solution: Useful for troubleshooting cycle irregularities.

knowledge_base.description: Contains technical specifications and dimensions of the machine.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: View M/C Spec from the sidebar for maintenance or capacity checks.
knowledge_base.solution: Contact the manufacturer for any part replacements.

knowledge_base.description: Allows manual operation of the machine for setup purposes.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Navigate to Settings -> Manual Control to jog machine axes.
knowledge_base.solution: Ensure safety protocols are followed during manual movement.

knowledge_base.description: Track production progress against specific orders.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Press 'Select W.O.' on the dashboard to assign an order.
knowledge_base.solution: Actual count updates automatically as parts are produced.

knowledge_base.description: Cp = (USL - LSL) / (6 * Sigma). It measures the potential capability of a process if it were perfectly centered.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: View Cp on the Dashboard donut charts. It uses the last 30 days of data.
knowledge_base.solution: If Cp is low, investigate machine repeatability and variation.

knowledge_base.description: Cpk = min((USL - Mean)/(3*SD), (Mean - LSL)/(3*SD)). It measures the actual process capability considering the mean centering.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Refreshed every 30 seconds on the Dashboard. High Cpk (>1.33) indicates a high-quality process.
knowledge_base.solution: If Cpk is much lower than Cp, the process mean is shifted. Adjust recipe parameters/offsets.

knowledge_base.description: Ppk uses Total Variation (Population SD) instead of within-subgroup variation. It describes how the process actually performed.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Displayed on the Dashboard as a key quality metric.
knowledge_base.solution: Ideally Ppk should be close to Cpk for a stable process.

knowledge_base.description: OEE = Availability x Performance x Quality. It is a gold standard for measuring manufacturing productivity.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Tracked live on the Dashboard from PLC data.
knowledge_base.solution: Availability: Machine uptime. Performance: Actual vs Target speed. Quality: Good vs NG parts.

knowledge_base.description: OAE = Availability x Performance x Quality. Similar to OEE, it measures how effectively assets are utilized.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: View OAE/OEE donut chart on the main process screen.
knowledge_base.solution: Analyze downtime reasons to improve overall effectiveness.

knowledge_base.description: Initiates the automatic hydraulic cycle based on the active recipe.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Press the Green START button in the header (if authorized).
knowledge_base.solution: Ensure all safety guards are closed before starting.

knowledge_base.description: Stops the automatic cycle safely after the current stroke finishes.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Press the Red STOP button in the header.
knowledge_base.solution: For immediate stop, use the physical Emergency Stop mushroom button.

knowledge_base.description: Sends the current recipe parameters from the HMI database to the PLC registers.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Press 'WRITE PLC' on the Recipe page.
knowledge_base.solution: Wait for the 'Success' confirmation before starting a cycle.

knowledge_base.description: Fetches the current live parameters from the PLC and updates the HMI screen.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Press 'READ PLC' on the Recipe page.
knowledge_base.solution: Useful to see what settings the machine is currently using.

knowledge_base.description: Stores the on-screen parameters into the local HMI database.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Press 'SAVE' or 'SAVE AS' to store the product profile.
knowledge_base.solution: Give recipes descriptive names like 'REAR_FENDER_V2'.

knowledge_base.description: Generates and saves a detailed report of production logs in .xlsx format.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Go to Reports, select Date/Work Order, and click 'EXPORT EXCEL'.
knowledge_base.solution: Reports include timestamps, pressures, and operator names.

knowledge_base.description: Begins logging live pressure and position data to the trend database.
knowledge_base.how_to_use: Press 'START RECORDING' on the Trend page.
knowledge_base.solution: Trends help analyze part quality over time.
